versions.changelog: Add skill cards and standardized growth registry metadata
Switch public terms to CC BY-NC-SA + commercial license

Initial release of creator-deal-ops skill for managing brand deal workflows:

- Supports end-to-end sponsorship workflow: from inbound brief intake to delivery and payment tracking
- Provides structure for intake qualification, defining deliverables, and risk/margin evaluation
- Includes non-negotiable guardrails for revisions, rights, and payment clarity
- Generates four outputs: deal scorecard, redline terms, delivery checklist, and payment tracker
- Emphasizes clear, actionable language and protection of creator interests
